title: GraphSmith obligations-to-controls register (register Lane B)
description: Declarative map from a regulatory obligation to the GraphSmith control(s) that produce evidence for it, plus an HONEST coverage verdict. C2-binding (PB-8 fail-closed): unmapped/partial/misplaced coverage MUST resolve to not-covered; an obligation with no executable control is manual-only and can NEVER be auto-marked covered. This register produces evidence, never a 'compliant' verdict. Frozen Wave 0 (v0.3.0).

controls.description: GraphSmith controls addressing this obligation. Empty array => manual-only (no executable control).

evidence_artifact.description: The concrete evidence demonstrating the control ran. Absent => coverage cannot be 'covered'.

coverage.description: HONEST coverage verdict. Fail-closed default is not-covered (C2). 'covered' requires a present, matching evidence_artifact AND a non-empty controls list; an empty controls list MUST be manual-only, never covered.

evidence_vs_judgment.description: Explicit split: what GraphSmith evidence attests vs what remains human judgment. Prevents a customer treating machine evidence as a compliance attestation (PB-8).

graphsmith_evidence.description: What the cited control/evidence actually demonstrates.

human_judgment.description: What a human must still assess; non-empty for manual-only obligations.
